Waterstons is an IT consultancy that helps organisations get the best out of their technology through security, user-friendly systems, data, software, and strategy. The Graduate Software Developer will work on challenging software projects across the full software lifecycle, from design to build, using technologies such as C#/.NET, React, SQL, Azure, and AI while learning DevOps practices.

Culture & Values
Responsibilities
From day one you will be involved in challenging and varied work which will have a real impact on the lives of our clients
From design to build, you’ll be involved in the whole software lifecycle
You will get to work with a range of technologies such as C#/.NET, React, SQL, Azure and of course AI
You could also work with products like Microsoft SharePoint and Power Platform, and will learn DevOps best practices and principles as you go
We have regular fun hack days, knowledge shares where we share interesting projects with other teams, and fun workshops with our clients
Qualification

A healthy work life balance with flexible and agile working being the norm
Flexible holiday allowance, with a minimum of 30 days a year
EV car scheme (salary sacrifice)
Room to grow with supported development opportunities and sponsored training
Enhanced family policies
Company sick pay and life assurance
Supported wellbeing with regular initiatives, an employee assistance programme and private medical insurance
Flexible benefits such as a dental scheme, eye care support, season ticket loan and cycle to work
Opportunities to get involved in CSR
